summary.text: Brady Bremer is the Democratic candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 64, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Bozeman renter and campus organizer at Montana State University who has served as a precinct leader in House District 64.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Brady Bremer said he rents in Bozeman, grew up on a small cattle ranch, and has been an organizer on the Montana State University campus and a precinct leader in House District 64.

He said he has worked as an opinion writer and newspaper deliverer for the MSU Exponent, and as a member of the Montana College Democrats helped organize events, including a 2024 effort that registered over 2,000 students to vote.
Bremer listed affordable housing, universal childcare and tax changes, including higher taxes on corporations and a small wealth tax on millionaires, as his key campaign messages.
